name: @corca-ai/ceal-cli-repository
description: Ceal worker CLI and client source; Gateway protocol/operator compatibility inputs are frozen

scripts.build: npm --prefix packages/ceal-protocol run build && npm --prefix packages/ceal-client run build && npm --prefix packages/ceal-worker-cli run build && npm --prefix packages/ceal-operator-cli run build
scripts.test:unit: npm --prefix packages/ceal-protocol test && npm --prefix packages/ceal-client test && npm --prefix packages/ceal-worker-cli test && npm --prefix packages/ceal-operator-cli test
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:contract && npm run test:release
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run build && npm test
scripts.check:unit: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run test:contract
